description: This Java class models the <jndi-jdbc> element within an entity configuration schema, encapsulating JNDI-related settings such as server name and JNDI name. It reads attribute values from an XML element and performs validation, throwing an exception if required attributes are missing.

classes.name: JndiJdbc
classes.description: Models the <jndi-jdbc> element, providing accessors for JNDI server name and JNDI name derived from XML configuration.

methods.name: getJndiServerName
methods.description: Returns the JNDI server name read from the configuration attribute.

methods.name: getJndiName
methods.description: Returns the JNDI name read from the configuration attribute.
